verdict.rationale: Unit documents a dedicated Sandbox environment on its own base URL (api.s.unit.sh). It is described as a full replica of production in which all standard endpoints behave the same, plus simulation endpoints for payment clearing, wire receipt, card settlement and statements, so integrations can be tested end-to-end before going live. The vendor's Postman collection also defaults to the Sandbox, giving a ready-made way to try requests without touching production. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of sandbox behavior, and an explicit statement that sandbox data is isolated from production.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data

citations.quote: Unit's Sandbox environment is a full replica of the production environment — all standard API endpoints work exactly the same way. Use it to build and test your integration end-to-end before going live.
